{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-7dvx","title":"[review] project-LICHEN-worker6-kd8m: CBOR map header claims 3 entries but only 2 encoded in EDHOC credential","description":"## Bug

Commit 29724205 changed `0xa2` → `0xa3` in two EDHOC credential encoding functions (`raw_key_credential` at line 1493 and `encode_credential` at line 1504 in `rust/lichen-oscore/src/edhoc.rs`).

The CBOR map header `0xa3` declares 3 key-value pairs, but the code only pushes 2:
- Entry 1: `0x01` (key = 1) → `0x06` (value = 6)  
- Entry 2: `0x20` (key = -1, CBOR negative integer) → bstr(pubkey)

This is a mismatched CBOR map size — the header claims 3 entries but only 2 are encoded. Any CBOR decoder will fail or read past the buffer boundary.

### Impact
- EDHOC handshake credential encoding produces malformed CBOR
- Will cause interop failures with spec-compliant EDHOC implementations

### Root cause
The header was changed from `0xa2` (correct for 2 entries) to `0xa3` (incorrect — 3 entries) without adding a third key-value pair.","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"agent@lichen-project.dev","created_at":"2026-07-24T19:31:25.275732188Z","created_by":"AI Agent","updated_at":"2026-07-24T19:31:25.275732188Z"}
